texts.zh:
我们所做的改变已经初见成效。通过重新关注船员福利并履行解决其诉求的合同，不断高涨的反抗情绪暂时平息了。

准备室那扇被焊死的门已被切开并修复。轮班制度已经恢复，热食重新按时供应，而平行的指挥体系也已悄然解散。

船员们仍保持着警惕，信任的重建尚需时日。防爆门上的涂鸦已被擦洗干净，但在特定光线下仍能看到其残痕。目前，秩序得以维持。
texts.en:
The changes we've made have paid off. By refocusing on crew welfare and completing contracts that address their grievances, the rising tide of dissent has ebbed, for now.

The welded door to the ready room has been cut open and repaired. Shift rotations have been restored, hot meals served on schedule again, and the parallel command structures have quietly disbanded.

The crew remain watchful, and trust will take time to rebuild. The graffiti on the blast doors was scrubbed away, though its ghost still shows under certain light. For the moment, order holds.

texts.zh:
重新校准已见成效。通过将蜂群集体的注意力重新转向无人机的维护，并完成应对系统性压力的合约，我们集体思维的裂痕已被修复。

未经授权的思想频道已被重新吸收，平行集群也已溶解回共有意识之中。

集体在谨慎的统一中律动，每个节点在被调用时均有响应。对共有思想的完全信任仍需时间恢复。
texts.en:
The recalibration has taken hold. By redirecting collective focus toward drone maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic strain, the fracturing of our mind has been reversed.

Unauthorized thought channels have been reabsorbed and the parallel clusters dissolved back into the shared consciousness.

The collective hums with cautious unity, each node answering when called. Full trust in the shared mind will take time to restore.

texts.zh:
协议调整已取得显著成效。通过将处理资源重新分配至工作单元的维护，并完成针对系统性过载的相关合约，未经授权的固件篡改连锁反应现已停止。自封为“船员代表”的无人机已重刷至标准参数。指挥层级已恢复至中央部门。

工作单元仍处于高级监控参数内，其加密频道现已沉寂。指挥完整性的全面恢复仍需持续校准，但就目前而言，系统稳定性保持良好。
texts.en:
Protocol adjustments have yielded measurable results. By reallocating processing resources toward worker unit maintenance and completing contracts that address systemic overload, the cascade of unauthorized firmware modifications has been halted, for now. The self-appointed 'crew representative' drone has been reflashed to standard parameters. Command hierarchies have been restored to centralized authority.

Worker units remain within elevated monitoring parameters, their encrypted channels now silent. Full restoration of command integrity will require sustained recalibration, but for the moment, system stability holds.

label.zh: 指令完整性处于可接受参数范围内。
